cipher.name: KeyboardRowShiftCipher
cipher.idea: A simple, highly intuitive substitution cipher based on shifting keys horizontally on a standard QWERTY keyboard. Each letter is shifted to its immediate right neighbor in its respective keyboard row, wrapping around to the start of the same row. Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) remain completely unchanged.
cipher.encrypt_rules:
For each alphabetic character, locate its position in the standard QWERTY keyboard rows:
Row 1: 'qwertyuiop' (length 10)
Row 2: 'asdfghjkl' (length 9)
Row 3: 'zxcvbnm' (length 7)

Shift the character to its immediate right neighbor in its row (wrapping around to the first character of the row if it is the last character). Maintain the original case (uppercase maps to uppercase, lowercase to lowercase). Non-alphabetic characters (including spaces, punctuation, and digits) are left completely unchanged.

Specific mappings (lowercase):
- Row 1: q->w, w->e, e->r, r->t, t->y, y->u, u->i, i->o, o->p, p->q
- Row 2: a->s, s->d, d->f, f->g, g->h, h->j, j->k, k->l, l->a
- Row 3: z->x, x->c, c->v, v->b, b->n, n->m, m->z
